edges.subject: MFSD8
edges.quote: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 7 (CLN7), one of the late infantile-onset NCLs, is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by mutations in the MFSD8 gene on chromosome 4q28.

edges.subject: CLN7
edges.quote: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs) are among the most common progressive encephalopathies of childhood.
